picks.editorial_note: A $14.2M DOE Genesis Mission award to build a foundation model for the national electric grid is a major federal bet on AI infrastructure resilience, with Brookhaven National Lab leading and Stony Brook collaborating.
picks.title: BNL to Lead $14M AI Project for Nation's Electric Grid Through Genesis Mission

picks.editorial_note: University of Kentucky's selection for DOE's 'Mine of the Future' initiative marks a significant academic-government partnership applying AI to critical minerals and energy infrastructure.
picks.title: UK selected to help advance DOE ‘Mine of the Future’ initiative

picks.editorial_note: A $10M OpenAI Foundation grant to Notre Dame's AIM for Scale initiative will bring AI-powered weather and crop-disease forecasting to millions of farmers, a rare case of a leading AI company directly funding real-world agricultural impact.
picks.title: AIM for Scale receives $10 million to bring AI-powered weather services to millions of farmers

picks.editorial_note: Rutgers and RWJBarnabas Health's new AWS-powered Innovation Hub represents a substantial academic-industry-healthcare partnership positioned to accelerate AI in medical education and clinical care.
picks.title: Rutgers and RWJBarnabas Health to Launch Innovation Hub, Powered by Amazon Web Services

picks.editorial_note: NIST's $30M-plus award to 12 Manufacturing Extension Partnership centers will help small and mid-sized manufacturers across 11 states adopt AI and robotics, a broad-reach federal investment in industrial AI adoption.
picks.title: NIST Awards More Than $30 Million for MEP Centers in 11 States and Puerto Rico

picks.editorial_note: King's College London researchers used AI on genomic 'dark genome' signatures to improve prediction of chemotherapy response, a genuinely novel scientific approach with direct clinical treatment implications.
picks.title: Ancient viral remnants in our genome may help predict response to chemotherapy | King's College London

picks.editorial_note: UAB's work combining electronic medical records and RNA sequencing in AI foundation models to predict cancer treatment response could meaningfully improve personalized oncology care.
picks.title: How one researcher is working toward AI use for cancer patient treatment

picks.editorial_note: University of Houston's combination of AlphaFold AI screening with quantum sensing to fight antibiotic-resistant superbugs like MRSA tackles a major public health threat with a novel interdisciplinary method.
picks.title: University of Houston Awarded $1.26M NIH Grant to Outsmart Superbugs | University of Houston

picks.editorial_note: A Virginia Tech alum's startup MorphLabs is developing noninvasive AI-powered brain-computer bridges to let amputees control prosthetics, a striking real-world application of foundation models in assistive medical technology.
picks.title: Engineering alum's medical startup aims to empower amputees with AI-linked prosthetics
picks.university: Virginia Polytechnic Institute and State University

picks.editorial_note: A UMass Amherst national poll finding only 11% of Americans support local AI data center construction, with 65% opposed across party lines, signals a growing political headwind that could shape AI infrastructure policy nationwide.
picks.title: Just 1 in 9 Americans Support AI Data Center Construction in their Local Communities, According to New UMass Amherst Poll | UMass Amherst
